senses.def: An m-ary tree data structure with a variable but often large number of children per node. It can be viewed as a B-tree in which each node contains only keys (not key–value pairs), and to which an additional level is added at the bottom with linked leaves.
An indexed data structure suitable for storage of a large number of items in a balanced fashion, with very few disk accesses required for locating the correct record block.
Any Russian or Soviet facility designated for the repair, recommissioning, and scrapping of tanks and other armoured vehicles; a tank-repair factory.
A village and commune of Hunedoara County, Romania.
